name: ASM-022 mini conveyor roller module assembly benchmark
description: Intermediate hierarchical CAD assembly benchmark for a compact driven conveyor roller module used in small manufacturing cells.

tasks.prompt: Create a mini conveyor roller module assembly with a base frame, paired side rails, six repeated conveyor rollers on shafts, repeated bearing blocks, a drive motor, and mounting feet. Use robust boxes/cylinders/compounds and keep the assembly fast to generate.
assumptions: Functional repeated rollers, shafts, bearing blocks, and feet are modeled as actual assembly occurrences.
Simple solid pins and raised bosses stand in for detailed bearings and fasteners to keep generation reliable.
Generated STEP, GLB, and topology artifacts are benchmark outputs, not source files.
